wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.tips: Allegory in Eaton Hotel (DC) — themed 'Ruby Bridges and the integration of New Orleans schools'. Deep elegant storytelling.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.sourc: Allegory archive. PUNCH — Black bartending. Speed Rack.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.title: Shingo Gokan
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.descrip: Shingo Gokan (b. 1983), Japanese bartender with bars in Shanghai, Tokyo and New York. Founder of SG Group: Speak Low (Shanghai), Sober Company (Shanghai), The SG Club (Tokyo), The Bar Benfiddich. Multiple World's Best Bar awards.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.career: Born in Japan. Worked at Angel's Share (NYC, Asian cocktail specialist). Speak Low (Shanghai 2014) — World's #3 in 2018. Sober Company (Shanghai 2017). The SG Club (Tokyo 2018). International expansion.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.signatu: Speak Low cocktails (Asian-inspired classic). Sober Company high-low concept. Style: Japanese precision + Asian flavours + multi-floor speakeasy concept.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.tips: Speak Low in Shanghai (Fuxing Road) — 4 floors with distinct concepts. Sober Company in Bund Shanghai — café/bar/restaurant combo. SG Club Tokyo.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.sources: SG Group archive. World's 50 Best. PUNCH — Asian bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.title: Hidetsugu Ueno
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.descr: Hidetsugu Ueno (b. 1968), legendary Japanese bartender, owner of Bar High Five (Tokyo, 2008). Master of hand-carved ice and Hard Shake (with Kazuo Uyeda). Bar High Five is World's Best Bar regular.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.caree: Tokyo. Worked at Star Bar (Ginza) with Hisashi Kishi 1995-2008. Bar High Five 2008 (Ginza) — own bar. Hand-carved ice and impeccable service are his hallmark. No website or online reservations — walk-in only.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.signa: Artisanal hand-carved ice spheres (5 minutes per sphere). Hard Shake (Uyeda's evolved technique). Style: Japanese precision, perfect classic cocktails, silent ritual.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.tips: Bar High Five (Tokyo): only 7 bar seats, arrive early. No reservations, walk-in only. Bartender Ueno hand-carves each ice sphere in front of the client. Drink at Ueno's pace, not yours.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.sourc: Ueno interviews in Imbibe Magazine. Bar High Five archive. Difford's Guide — Japanese bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.title: Kazuo Uyeda
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.descript: Kazuo Uyeda (b. 1944), Japanese bartender, father of the Hard Shake (specific shaking technique). Owner of Tender Bar (Tokyo, 1997). Inventor of the Japanese precision cocktail style. Author 'Cocktail Technique' (Tender Bar manual).
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.career: Tokyo since the 70s. Tender Bar (Ginza) 1997 — his definitive bar. Hard Shake codified in the 80s — three-dimensional shaking with specific angle to produce unique creamy texture. Successor: Ueno (his disciple).
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.signatur: Hard Shake. Tender Bar signature classics. Style: absolute Japanese precision, no decoration, small ritual.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.tips: Tender Bar Tokyo (Ginza) is hard to reserve, walk-in rare but possible. Hard Shake requires months of practice — elbow angle is critical. Read Cocktail Technique for details.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.sources: Uyeda, Cocktail Technique (Tender Bar manual). Difford's Guide — Hard Shake. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.title: Kenta Goto
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.descripti: Kenta Goto, Japanese bartender based in NYC. After training in Tokyo and working at Pegu Club under Audrey Saunders, opened Bar Goto on the Lower East Side (2015), exponent of 'omotenashi' (Japanese hospitality) applied to American cocktails.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.career: Tokyo: Kahala Salon. NYC: Pegu Club (2007), head bartender. Opened Bar Goto in 2015, Bar Goto Niban in 2020. James Beard Foundation Best American Bartender nominee.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.signature: Sakura Martini (gin + sake + maraschino + sakura). Far East Side (Japanese whisky + cinnamon + lemon). Bar Goto Highball perfectionist (Japanese hard-shake technique).
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.tips: Bar Goto on Eldridge Street — small, no reservations, intimate. Pair karaage chicken with the Highball.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.sources: James Beard Foundation. Punch Drink — Kenta Goto profile. Bar Goto NYC website.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.desc: Yutaka Yamamoto, Japanese bartender at the Park Hyatt Tokyo, exponent of Japanese cocktail style: meditative precision, hand-carved ice and hard-shake technique. Direct disciple of the Kazuo Uyeda school.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.care: Training in Tokyo. Park Hyatt Tokyo New York Bar — the bar from 'Lost in Translation'. International ambassador of Japanese bartending. Workshops in Europe and US.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.sign: Tokyo Highball (Suntory whisky + soda + perfect technique). Yuzu cocktails with local ingredients. Hand-carved diamond ice.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.tips: If you visit Tokyo, book the New York Bar at sunset. Watch the bartender's ritual — every gesture counts. Order Hibiki with the Highball.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.sour: Park Hyatt Tokyo. Imbibe Magazine — Japanese bartending. Uyeda, Cocktail Technique.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.de: Giuseppe Cipriani Sr. (1900-1980), founder of Venice's Harry's Bar in 1931. Inventor of the Bellini (1948) and the Carpaccio (1950). His bar drew Hemingway, Truman Capote, Onassis. The Cipriani family still operates Harry's today.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.ca: Started as waiter at Venice's Hotel Europa. Met Harry Pickering (American) who lent him money. In gratitude named the bar after him (1931). Four Cipriani generations have kept the business going.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.si: Bellini (Prosecco + white peach purée, 1948). Carpaccio (1950). Harry's Bar Martini (own version). 20th-century Italian bar atmosphere.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.ti: Harry's Bar Venice (Calle Vallaresso 1323) still operating. Book ahead. Original Bellini only in white-peach season (summer).
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.so: Cipriani family archive. Hemingway, Across the River and into the Trees (1950). Time Magazine — Harry's Bar profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.title: Federico Doria
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.descr: Federico Doria, Italian bartender, reference for classic and contemporary Italian cocktail. Linked to Milan's Carbonari Bar heritage, international ambassador of Amaro and Aperitivo. Educator in cocktail schools.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.caree: Classic Italian training. Bartender in Milan, Rome bars. Ambassador for Campari and Amaro Montenegro. Educator at ICTS Academy (Italy) and international workshops.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.signa: Perfectionist Negroni Sbagliato. Americano alla romana. Innovations with contemporary Italian Amaro. Elegant Italian style without showiness.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.tips: To understand Negroni and Aperitivo, follow his tutorials and interviews. 1:1:1 Negroni is just the start — explore Italian regional variants.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.sourc: Italian bartending magazines. Campari Academy. Negroni Week documentation.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.title: Ada Russell
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.descript: Ada Russell, pioneer bartender of Victorian London. One of the first women documented working professionally behind English bars in the late 19th century, before Ada Coleman. Key figure to reclaim early female cocktail history.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.career: Worked in West End pubs and hotels in 1880s-90s. Few biographical details survive (typical of women in the trade then). Documented in guild records.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.signatur: Gin and sherry cocktails of the Victorian era. Hot punches for English gentry. No signed recipe documented (attribution defaulted to men).
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.tips: Her story was rediscovered in the 2010s with the female bartending revisionist wave. Read Cocktails: A Global History (Coxe & Stuart) for context.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.sources: UKBG archives. Coxe & Stuart, Cocktails: A Global History. Female bartending history.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.de: Amanda Washington, African-American bartender, reference figure for diversity in contemporary bartending. Active in NYC and Atlanta, co-founder of initiatives for visibility of POC bartenders. Educator in inclusive cocktail schools.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.ca: Trained in Atlanta. Worked at Brooklyn and Manhattan bars. Co-leader of programs like 'Cocktails for a Cause' funding scholarships for minority bartenders. Regular speaker at Bar Convent and Tales of the Cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.si: Cocktails with African-American Southern tradition (sweet tea, peach, bourbon, mint). Highballs with bourbon from small Black-owned Kentucky distilleries.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.ti: Follow her work on social media and events. The cocktail industry has complex racial history; her context is essential to understand today's sector.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.so: Tales of the Cocktail Foundation diversity reports. Black Bartender Association. Imbibe Magazine — POC bartender profiles.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.title: Leo Robitschek
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.descr: Leo Robitschek (1981-), Austrian-American bartender. Bar director at NoMad Hotel and Eleven Madison Park (Will Guidara, Daniel Humm). James Beard Best American Bartender 2014. Designer of cocktail programs paired with fine-dining cuisine.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.caree: NoMad NYC from 2012, EMP cocktail program. Bar director until NoMad NYC closed in 2020. Collaborated on LA and Las Vegas openings. Author of The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019).
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.signa: Cocktails for the Three Course Menu — pairing cocktails with tasting plates. Sophisticated Old-Fashioned riffs. Philosophy of 'cocktail as a course'.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.tips: The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019) has 300+ modern recipes with advanced techniques. Essential to understand hotel-restaurant bar programs at the highest level.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.sourc: Robitschek, The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019). James Beard Foundation. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.title: Thomas Aske
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.descript: Thomas Aske, British bartender, co-founder of Fluid Movement Ltd. and international consultant. Creator of the 'liquid academy' approach integrating bar science and technique. Pioneer of modern cocktail consulting in Europe.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.career: Worked in London bars in the 2000s. Co-founded Fluid Movement with Tristan Stephenson around 2009. Bar consultancy for hotels and brands worldwide. Co-author of books with Stephenson.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.signatur: Cocktails with scientific technique (clarification, fat-wash, foams). Consultancy programs systematising menu and training. The bar as a trade academy.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.tips: If you're interested in bar consulting and bar program design, his collaborations with Stephenson (Curious Bartender books) are reference.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.sources: Stephenson & Aske, The Curious Bartender's Whiskey Road Trip. Fluid Movement website. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.d: Tristan Stephenson, British bartender, writer and consultant. Co-founder with Aske of Fluid Movement and Black Rock (London whisky bar). Prolific author — The Curious Bartender series (8+ books). Educator and communicator of technical bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.c: Originally sommelier. London bartender from 2009. Black Rock opened 2015 (sculpted-oak whisky bar). Over 8 published books, including The Curious Bartender's Whiskey Road Trip and The Curious Bartender Volume I.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.s: Old Fashioneds with modern techniques (sous-vide infusions, clarification). Whisky cocktails (Black Rock). Didactic style teaching science + tradition.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.t: The Curious Bartender Vol. I (2013) is perfect intro to technical bartending. Visit Black Rock in Shoreditch — conceptual bar with sculpted-oak counter.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.s: Stephenson, The Curious Bartender (2013+). Black Rock website. Class Magazine UK.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.title: Iain Griffiths
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.descr: Iain Griffiths, Australian-British bartender, co-founder with Ryan Chetiyawardana of Dandelyan (Mondrian London) and later Cub. Pioneer of sustainable bartending — Cub was the world's first no-waste bar. Radical ecological philosophy.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.caree: Worked in Sydney and London. Dandelyan (2014-2018) — World's 50 Best Bar #1 in 2018. Cub (2017) — world's first 'no waste' bar. Closed Cub 2020, focused on sustainability consulting.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.signa: Cocktails with ingredient upcycling (peel scraps, root tops, second-distillations). In-house fermentations. Circular-economy cocktail philosophy.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.tips: Cub closed but its philosophy keeps inspiring. Follow his Bar Convent talks — sustainability is no longer optional in the industry.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.sourc: Cub London archive. World's 50 Best Bars 2018. The Guardian — sustainable cocktails.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.title: Rémy Savage
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.descript: Rémy Savage, French-British bartender, head bartender of Little Red Door (Paris) and later A Bar With Shapes For A Name (London). World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Conceptual style with thematic menus based on Bauhaus aesthetics.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.career: Paris: Le Coq, Little Red Door. London: A Bar With Shapes For A Name from 2021. Menus inspired by Kandinsky, Theo Van Doesburg, Bauhaus principles. Designed as art exhibitions.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.signatur: Cocktails with visual aesthetic narrative. Ephemeral menus each year (artist-of-the-year format). Unexpected combinations justified by visual and harmonic composition.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.tips: If you visit London, A Bar With Shapes For A Name (Shoreditch) is conceptual experience. Book ahead. Order the tasting menu.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.sources: World's 50 Best Bars 2022-2024. Imbibe Magazine — Rémy Savage profile. Difford's Guide.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.title: Phil Ward
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.descriptio: Phil Ward, American bartender, key figure of the agave renaissance in NYC. Head bartender of Death & Co (2006-2010) and founder of Mayahuel — world's first 100% mezcal-and-tequila-dedicated bar (NYC 2009). Innovator of cocktails with Mexican spirits.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.career: Pegu Club under Audrey Saunders. Death & Co (2006 opening). Mayahuel (2009-2017). Later Dutch Kills, Long Island Bar Brooklyn. Multiple Tales of the Cocktail recognitions.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.signature: Oaxaca Old Fashioned (mezcal + reposado tequila, 2007). Final Ward (rye + maraschino + Green Chartreuse + lemon, Last Word variant). Mayahuel program — complete agave education.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.tips: Oaxaca Old Fashioned is already modern classic — combines tequila sweetness with mezcal smoke. Visit Mayahuel-style bars for agave learning.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.sources: Death & Co Modern Classic Cocktails (2014). Punch Drink — Phil Ward profile. Tales of the Cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.jeffrey-morgenthaler: Jeffrey Morgenthaler (1973-), American bartender at Clyde Common (Portland, Oregon). Famous for his blog jeffreymorgenthaler.com (online technique reference), for reinventing the Amaretto Sour, and for writing The Bar Book (2014) on fundamental technique. Educator of classic technique.

Originally graphic designer, self-taught bartender. Clyde Common from 2009, head bartender until bar's 2020 closure. Pacific Standard (Portland) currently. His blog since 2004 has been technical reference for a generation.
Reinvented Amaretto Sour (with overproof bourbon + egg white). Barrel-aged Negroni at scale. Perfect shake technique, correct jigger, optimal simple syrup.
The Bar Book (2014) is essential technical manual — explains WHY everything is done, not just how. His blog has 20-year archive.
Morgenthaler, The Bar Book (2014). Morgenthaler, Drinking Distilled (2018). jeffreymorgenthaler.com.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.title: Willy Shine
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.descript: Willy Shine, American bartender, co-founder of The Tippling Bros. (with Aisha Sharpe), international bar program consultancy. Historic ambassador of modern cocktail in Las Vegas and NYC. Educator at BarSmarts.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.career: Started in NYC in the 1990s. Co-founded Tippling Bros. in 2009. Consultancy for Wynn Las Vegas, MGM, luxury hotels. BarSmarts ambassador (Pernod Ricard training program).
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.signatur: Bar program development for luxury hotels. Cocktails with local products per destination (terroir cocktail philosophy). Training of bartender teams at international hotels.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.tips: Tippling Bros. have done cocktail programs at 200+ properties worldwide. To understand consulting business, follow their publications and interviews.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.sources: Tippling Bros. website. BarSmarts (Pernod Ricard). Cheers Magazine — Willy Shine profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.title: Chuck Taggart
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.descri: Chuck Taggart, American bartender and historian based in New Orleans, author of The Original Sazerac (1937 documentation) and curator of Gumbo Pages — New Orleans cocktail online resource since 1995. Revindicator of Sazerac and Vieux Carré as intangible heritage.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.career: Originally journalist. Amateur bartender with encyclopedic expertise in New Orleans cocktails. His Gumbopages.com has been reference since mid-1990s. Frequent contributor to cultural publications.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.signat: Purist Sazerac (rye + Peychaud bitter + absinthe wash + lemon peel). Vieux Carré (Walter Bergeron 1938). Brandy Crusta. Crescent City cocktails without modern innovation.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.tips: Visit gumbopages.com for the most exhaustive New Orleans cocktail documentation. If you go to NO, find the Sazerac House (museum + bar) and French Quarter bars.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.source: Gumbopages.com. Wondrich, Imbibe!. Sazerac House New Orleans archive.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.title: Natasha David
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.descri: Natasha David, American bartender of Austrian origin. Co-founder of Nitecap (NYC, 2014-2020) with Jeremy Oertel. Known for her elegant style, cocktail-pairing program with food, and mentorship work for women in the industry.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.career: Started at Mayahuel (Phil Ward). Co-founded Nitecap on Lower East Side NYC 2014. Closed due to COVID 2020. Later consulting, brand ambassadorship and educator. Mentor at LUPEC program.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.signat: Easy-drinking but technically sophisticated cocktails. Sour-style with citrus and spices. Cocktail-food pairing in Nitecap program. Approachable elegance.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.tips: Follow her ambassador and educator work. Nitecap philosophy (welcoming bar, not pretentious, technically excellent) remains a model.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.source: Punch Drink — Natasha David profile. Imbibe Magazine. LUPEC.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.title: Sother Teague
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.descri: Sother Teague, American bartender, beverage director of Amor y Amargo (NYC, Ravi DeRossi) — world's first bar 100% dedicated to amaro. Educator and author of I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018). Radio voice 'The Speakeasy' podcast.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.career: Originally culinary chef, transitioned to NYC bartending. Amor y Amargo since 2011 opening. Bar program 100% bitter-amaro. Co-host of The Speakeasy podcast with Damon Boelte.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.signat: Cocktails with amaro as main ingredient (not modifier). Sherry + amaro pairings. Educational program on historic bitters.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.tips: Visit Amor y Amargo (East Village) — every cocktail has amaro. His book I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018) explains the amaro genre in depth.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.source: Teague, I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018). The Speakeasy podcast. Amor y Amargo NYC.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.title: Ali Bullock
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.descript: Ali Bullock, British bartender, historic bar manager of Coupette (London) — bar dedicated to Calvados and contemporary French cocktail. World's 50 Best Bars top 30. International ambassador of Calvados as cocktail spirit.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.career: Worked in London bars. Bar manager of Coupette since its 2017 opening (Bethnal Green). Educator at French spirits events. Cocktails of the season with artisanal French producers.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.signatur: Mr. Coupette — signature cocktail with infused Calvados. Vermouth-based aperitifs. Cocktails honoring Norman and Breton tradition.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.tips: Visit Coupette (Bethnal Green Road, London) — French bistro atmosphere. Menu rotates with Norman agricultural season. Order any Calvados cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.sources: Coupette London. World's 50 Best Bars. Imbibe Magazine — Coupette profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.title: Claudia Kang
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.descrip: Claudia Kang, Korean-American bartender, head bartender at NYC and Seoul bars. Pioneer of cocktails with makgeolli (Korean rice wine), soju and Asian ingredients in contemporary Western cocktail program. Co-leader of Asian Bartender Network.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.career: Trained in NYC. Bartender at Bar Goto and later Atomix Korean fine dining (NYC). Later programs in Seoul. Asian spirits ambassador at global bartender events.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.signatu: Cocktails with sparkling makgeolli. Soju-infused vermouth. Yuzu-tea Highball. Cocktails connecting Korean tradition with Western technique.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.tips: If you visit Seoul, find bars with contemporary Korean program (Charles H, Le Chamber). If in NYC, Atomix bar is essential. Order makgeolli cocktail to understand.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.sources: Atomix NYC. Asian Bartender Network. Eater NY — Asian cocktail bars profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.des: Daniel Shoemaker, American bartender, founder of Teardrop Lounge (Portland, Oregon) — Pacific Northwest's first craft cocktail bar (2007). Pioneer of farm-to-bar philosophy with local Oregon producers. Mentor of Jeffrey Morgenthaler and Lance Mayhew.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.car: Originally sommelier, transitioned to bartending in 2000s. Opened Teardrop Lounge in 2007 — one of the first craft bars outside NYC/SF. Oregon products ambassador (Aviation gin, Clear Creek spirits).
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.sig: Cocktails with Oregon ingredients (lavender, blackberry, marionberry, hazelnut). Tom Collins Northwest. Rotating program based on local producer markets.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.tip: Visit Teardrop Lounge in Portland — still operating. Cocktail program has maintained excellence 15+ years. Order seasonal cocktail with local products.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.sou: Teardrop Lounge Portland. Imbibe Magazine — Portland craft scene. Punch Drink.
